RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Not reliably estimable from the information provided

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex bias. Giving a numerical probability would imply knowledge we don’t have.

Your qualifications are strong, but a leadership role may prioritize regulatory expertise, management experience, and interview performance over academic credentials. The announcement doesn’t establish her full qualifications.

Follow up now on your written request. Ask for the selection criteria, how your application was assessed, and feedback on the decisive differences—not explanations based on panel members’ sex.

If you uncover sex-based comments, inconsistent criteria, or procedural irregularities, consider a formal challenge. Check local complaint deadlines; waiting for feedback may not pause them.
